panels.title: Число скоров по версии модели
panels.description: Все сохранённые в БД скоры за выбранное время записи (фильтры продавца и штата не учитываются)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(model_version, 'unknown') AS model_version, COUNT(*) AS scores_count
FROM scores
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY model_version
ORDER BY model_version

panels.title: Доля фрода по версии модели
panels.description: Среднее количество срабатываний модели по заданному порогу (фильтры продавца и штата не учитываются)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(model_version, 'unknown') AS model_version, AVG(CAST(fraud_flag AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS fraud_share
FROM scores
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY model_version
ORDER BY model_version

panels.title: TPS выбранных транзакций
panels.description: Скорость сохрания результатов в БД с фильтром по штату и продавцу

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS start_at, $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS end_at
), buckets AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', start_at, TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01'),
        date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', end_at - INTERVAL '1 microsecond', TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01'),
        INTERVAL '10 seconds'
    ) AS bucket FROM bounds
), counts AS (
    SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', processed_at, TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01') AS bucket,
           COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM scores CROSS JOIN bounds
    WHERE processed_at >= start_at AND processed_at < end_at
      AND ('__all' = ANY(ARRAY[${us_state:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR us_state = ANY(ARRAY[${us_state:sqlstring}]::text[]))
      AND ('__all' = ANY(ARRAY[${merch:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR merch = ANY(ARRAY[${merch:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    GROUP BY bucket
)
SELECT GREATEST(b.bucket, bounds.start_at) AS time,
       COALESCE(c.n, 0)::double precision / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM
           LEAST(b.bucket + INTERVAL '10 seconds', bounds.end_at) - GREATEST(b.bucket, bounds.start_at)), 0) AS tps
FROM buckets b CROSS JOIN bounds
LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.bucket = b.bucket
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Плотность распределения скоров
panels.description: С учетом фильтра на штат и продавца

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected AS (
    SELECT LEAST(19, FLOOR(score * 20)::integer) AS bucket
    FROM scores
    WHERE $__timeFilter(processed_at)
      AND score BETWEEN 0 AND 1
      AND ('__all' = ANY(ARRAY[${us_state:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR us_state = ANY(ARRAY[${us_state:sqlstring}]::text[]))
      AND ('__all' = ANY(ARRAY[${merch:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR merch = ANY(ARRAY[${merch:sqlstring}]::text[]))
), counts AS (
    SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS n FROM selected GROUP BY bucket
), total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM selected
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(b.bucket * 0.05, 'FM0.00') || '–' || TO_CHAR((b.bucket + 1) * 0.05, 'FM0.00') AS score_interval,
       COALESCE(c.n, 0)::double precision / NULLIF(total.n * 0.05, 0) AS density
FROM generate_series(0, 19) AS b(bucket)
CROSS JOIN total
LEFT JOIN counts c USING (bucket)
ORDER BY b.bucket

panels.title: Доля фрода по категориям
panels.description: Последние 1000 записанных результатов в разбивке по категориям покупки

targets.rawSql:
WITH recent AS (
    SELECT cat_id, fraud_flag FROM scores
    ORDER BY id DESC
    LIMIT 1000
)
SELECT COALESCE(cat_id, 'unknown') AS cat_id,
       AVG(CAST(fraud_flag AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS fraud_share
FROM recent
GROUP BY cat_id
ORDER BY fraud_share DESC, cat_id
